description: Check the TLS certificate of one hostname: issuer, validity dates, days left, % of lifetime used, renewal cadence and a renewal-stall flag, plus a live HTTPS pass/fail probe. Use it when you only need certificate health; use site_health for cert + DNS + expiry together, or domain_grade for a scored A-F result. Certificate details come from public Certificate Transparency logs (Cert Spotter, crt.sh fallback), not from the live connection, so a brand-new cert may not show yet. Read-only; makes one HTTPS request to the host and one CT-log query, usually 1-5 s. Costs $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input or an upstream failure returns an error and is not charged.

domain.description: Hostname or URL, e.g. example.com or https://www.example.com/path
